entities.name: Euphrase Kezilahabi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Euphrase Kezilahabi was a Tanzanian novelist, poet, and scholar. Born in Ukerewe, Tanganyika, he last worked at the University of Botswana, as an associate professor at the Department of African Languages.
